subject: POC: Success Criteria & Evaluation Roster — kickoff and owners
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: erin.walters@healthstride.io, jake.morales@healthstride.io
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: POC: Success Criteria & Evaluation Roster — kickoff and owners

Hi Erin / Jake —

Thanks for taking the time last week. As discussed, we want to kick off a tight 8-week POC to validate latency/cost and generation quality against your intake workflows. Attached is a working mutual action plan (HealthStride_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) and a short eval spec (eval-bench-specs.md) to capture the benchmarks we recommended.

Key ask for today: confirm the internal owners on your side so we can lock responsibilities and dates. Our proposed owner split:
- Redwood PM: Markus Klein (overall POC lead)
- Redwood SRE/Infra: Marissa Cole (test harness & perf dashboards)
- Redwood Solutions: Priya Natarajan (prompt/eval design)
- Redwood Sales: Ben Carter (commercial sync & approvals)

What we need from HealthStride:
1) A technical owner for the ingestion & sample prompt set (to generate the eval dataset)
2) A business owner to confirm success criteria and acceptance tests
3) Any compliance/IT contacts if you want private-cloud deployment options evaluated

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Latency: median generation latency < 600ms for 95th percentile of standard prompts
- Quality: top-line correctness rate >= 92% on the acceptance prompt set (per your SME review)
- Cost: projected per-1k token inference cost <= your target of $0.85

Timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): owner confirmations + dataset handoff
- Week 1–2: eval harness & baseline runs
- Week 3–5: prompt optimization and quantization experiments
- Week 6–7: regression checks and production-readiness checklist
- Week 8: final review + go/no-go decision

If that looks good, please add any missing owners by end-of-day today and we'll circulate a locked MAP with milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Markus Klein
Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: HealthStride_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
Attachment: eval-bench-specs.md (text, 7KB)

Subject: Re: POC: Success Criteria & Evaluation Roster — kickoff and owners

Markus —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. I looped in Jake (tech lead) below. We can own the ingestion and provide the sample prompt sets by Friday COB. Confirming owners from our side:
- Technical owner: Jake Morales (tech lead) — will deliver dataset and access details
- Business owner: Erin Walters (Head of Product Ops) — will sign off on success criteria and acceptance tests
- Security/IT: I've asked our infra security to standby; I'll share their contact if we decide to test private deployment.

Two quick asks from HealthStride:
1) Can Redwood include a small A/B plan to compare the current model output vs Redwood-optimized model outputs side-by-side for the first 2 weeks? We want a controlled comparison for stakeholders.
2) For quality measurement, can you include a simple spreadsheet template for SME annotations? That will help speed up acceptance review.

Otherwise, happy with the milestones. We'll add contacts to the MAP spreadsheet and return it.

Best,
Erin
Head of Product Ops — HealthStride
erin.walters@healthstride.io

Hi all —

Thanks for confirming owners, Erin. I've attached an initial SME annotation template and a brief runbook for how we'll collect labels during the baseline runs (see attached eval-bench-specs.md). Summary of next steps from Redwood:

- Action: HealthStride to upload sample prompts + dataset to the shared Drive folder by Friday COB (Jake)
- Action: Redwood to deliver baseline A/B runs and a comparison report by end of Week 2 (Marissa + Markus)
- Action: Priya to distribute SME template and collect first 200 annotations by Week 3

Acceptance criteria (finalized at go/no-go):
1) SME acceptance rate >= 92% on annotated set (per Erin sign-off)
2) No regressions on top-10 business-critical prompts (predefined list)
3) Operational readiness checklist passed (tracing, cost forecasts, autoscale knobs)

If HealthStride is good with this, I'll lock the MAP spreadsheet and send a version-controlled link (we'll use the HubSpot deal folder).

Thanks — looking forward to the first data handoff.
